name: Kyogoku Iroha
source:
Another member of the Cyber Force Dolls; on stage, she stands right of Bambi. 21 years old.

Iroha is the oldest of the three-girl idol group, and has been a police officer the longest—thus, she is their de facto leader.

She may be well-mannered and quiet, but Iroha knows exactly who she is and what she wants; she doesn’t let anyone else’s opinions sway her own.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
